title: Include correctors that move with the dilation
statement: For fixed bounded Hessian S,the complete L4 normal-corrector infimum,including a-dependent choices,has at1/a the extended-real coefficient -(1/(8delta))min_ell integral (K-ell)²/|S|² with correct zero-weight convention;it may be minus infinity and finite dual value need not attain an L4 corrector. Uniform lower remainder plus fixed recovery closes infimum/limit exchange. If weight bounded below,equi-coercive weakL2 Gamma convergence gives strictly convex quadratic limit and strong almost-minimizer convergence. Otherwise at scale a^(-2/3),weakL4 Gamma limit is quartic cost on {S=0},with unique minimizer and negative cost exactly when nonlocal force varies there. Measure-zero zero set yields zero at that scale,not universal finite1/a coefficient.
